messages:
anna-people-ops: Quick heads-up: vendor migration next weekend may affect two things we didn't call out yesterday: employer HSA contributions timing and employees who choose mixed Roth/pre-tax split on deferrals. Need clarity before we send the hiring checklist. @claire-benefits @raj-payroll :wave:

raj-payroll: Thanks. HSA employer contributions are typically a monthly lump sum we push on the 1st business day after payroll closes. During cutover the vendor will only accept the payroll file lines it receives. If the file doesn't include the HSA contribution code, it won’t auto-post.

claire-benefits: To add: for employees with HSA elections, we require the enrollment effective date and contribution election in the HRIS before payroll file generation. If someone enrolls during the blackout, they're eligible but we need manual funding from the vendor later. That manual funding is separate from payroll and requires an HSA authorization form.

anna-people-ops: Got it. For Roth/pre-tax split: if a new hire selects 3% pre-tax and 2% Roth during enrollment but payroll sends only a total deferral amount (e.g., just 5% without split) will the vendor default everything to pre-tax?

raj-payroll: Operationally, our payroll export has fields for pretax and Roth. If HRIS is missing the split, payroll will populate pretax only. So yes, missing split => default pretax. We need HRIS data complete.

claire-benefits: Vendor note: they will apply whatever flags they receive. Retro-splitting (converting prior pretax to Roth) is non-trivial because of tax implications (corrected W-2s) and vendor fees. We can do a correction if the employee signs an election amendment and understands the tax consequences, but it's usually best to avoid.

tom-hrops: Practical ask: can payroll/benefits provide a small checklist template we can attach to offer letters so hiring managers confirm enrollment fields are set before the payroll cutoff? Would reduce manual fixes.

raj-payroll: Yes. Here's a minimal ticket template for off-cycle inclusion or manual HSA funding:

```
Employee: Sam Patel (ID 98765)
Action: Add pretax deferral 3% + Roth 2% effective 2026-04-16
Payroll period: 2026-04-16 to 2026-04-30
Deduction codes: RD401K_PRETAX, RD401K_ROTH
HSA employer funding: $150 for April (attach signed HSA form)
Submitter: Tom HR Ops
```

claire-benefits: Also note: HSA employer funding code is HSA_EMP_ADJ for manual vendor funding. Include signed HSA form and confirm employee SSN on the form matches payroll.

finance-bot: Automated notice: Manual off-cycle or vendor retro actions will increase accounts payable accruals and may require a reserve entry for month-end. Please tag the finance channel when submitting tickets.

anna-people-ops: Thanks everyone. Plan: I'll add the checklist + ticket template to the hiring ops runbook and circulate a short slack post to hiring and managers. I'll also include a brief note about tax implications for retro split/corrections so managers can advise candidates. Anything else? :memo:
